summary: this is a first party theme: a theme.json with css variables and terminal colors, a canvas effect script, a shared effects harness and an svg mascot. the scripts only read css custom properties, draw to a canvas and listen for resize, visibility and reduced-motion events. they make no network calls, read no storage or cookies, use no eval, and import only the sibling effects-base.js. there is no text addressed to an agent or reviewer. the two webp images were not shown, which is expected for a theme and is not a finding on its own.
